comment: Micro Theory is very hard, and Dolan is a great professor. He uses great examples that make it easier to pick up concepts despite the difficulty of the material. You will have to work extremely hard in order to do well. It is an extremely test heavy course. Supposedly he's 'easier' than McGoldrick, but very few students will earn an A.

The most challenging and the most fun course I have ever taken. Dr. Dolan is so wise that his lectures make you question your intellectual existence. He's also good at explaining ideas and may appear to be like a misanthropist but a true warm-heart person inside. Prepare to work hard and remain conscious in the face of his witty weekly quizzes.

The most challenging course I have EVER taken, but it is so worth it- Dr Dolan is the most intelligent man you will ever meet. He is intimidating, but very easily accessible and helpful at his office hours. If you're an econ major, take his class. He weeds out the weak, but once you make it through you have all the tools to succeed in the future

Dr. Dolan makes you love economics. His stories make the dull parts of the course go by. Does a great job of explaining difficult concepts. The grading on the tests are tough, but its possible to get an A. The class isnt alot of work if you are understanding the material. If you dont get it, then you should just quit.

He is a great professor and his class is very clear. He is also a very nice person, caring and friendly. Tests are hard and midterm takes 3 hours. Prepare to work really hard. He has different grading scale which is based on your score range.

Hands down my favorite teacher I have ever had and this was probably the hardest class I've ever taken if that puts things into perspective.  Extremely intelligent, you almost gain knowledge just from being in the same room.  Lots of work and effort needed for the course but you will leave feeling so intelligent.

I've never had such an aggressive, mean spirited teacher. I dreaded going to Dr. Dolan's class, as he frequently berates students for no reason whatsoever.  Dr. Dolan is very condescending when you meet with him outside of class.

Dr. Dolan knows a lot about economics but is very concerned about GPA and has told several students to drop his class because he didn't think they would succeed based off of how well they did two weeks into the semester. He is not the most clear with what he wants on assignments and has good office hours. Do not take.
Lectures are as clear as the Hawaiian skies, refreshing as a cold beer, and enlightening as thinkers like John Locke or Adam Smith. Take Dr. Dolan.
Best professor ever. I learned a ton from his class. He is extremely helpful, especially during his office hours. Take all of his courses without the slightest doubt.

I Hate Rob D though I ranked top in his class. His way of thinking is out of fashion, staying within his own circle can not help with his poor judgement on current affairs. A fuddy-duddy who feels good about himself. My final words, A professor should always keep his mind open and welcome all kinds of culture, Rob haven't achieved this.
Very challenging but I learned a lot about the subject.  Almost impossible to get an A.

One of the most challenging courses I've taken at U of R. Very difficult to get an A on his exams and weekly quizzes. It is possible, only if you study really hard. But one of the best professors I had here. Very knowledgeable

Hands down the best professor I know. You'll probably not get an A (very few do), but you'll learn so much. Econ is a pretty logic-intense subject, but he explains it like its algebra. If you don't understand the material during class, go to his office hours and you will have several epiphanies by merely being in his presence. No kidding
One of my favorite professors at UR. Great sense of humor, extremely accommodating and helpful—especially during office hours. I would recommend taking all of his courses
Loves natty light. Dolan is a very good teacher, however his class is challenging. In test, he expects you to spit out word for word what he said. Tough grader. Kind of arrogant in his own way.
not an easy A. But if you are really interested in Econ and thinking of majoring or minoring it, definitely take him! Best professor ever!

Dolan is the man. If you don't do the work, don't complain. It isn't an easy A, and problem set grades can be frustrating, but he definitely makes you learn, and has a great sense of humor. Take the time to get to know him, he's a really cool guy. If you're an econ major, take his class, no questions asked.
Not the best teacher ever like some people say, but he's pretty good.  But he LOVES himself.

Dolan is top 5 favorite professors here.  While every econ teacher knows what they're talking about, Dolan does a very good job engaging the class with examples of economic concepts that make sense.  His sense of humor is top notch as well.

Dr. Dolan knows his stuff and he definitely expects you to know yours after and while taking his class. Yes, the class if difficult but it possible to do well if you really put in the time. Class was very captivating and you learned so much every class. Problem sets are very helpful and you will definitely know your micro stuff by the end.

Very challenging, but worthwhile professor. Tests require a lot of studying and its very difficult to get a 100 on the problem sets. At the same time, I knew my stuff by the end. At times, his teaching style is wearisome and he sometimes is demeaning.

REALLY GOOD PROFESSOR! Very, very difficult though. He knows everything you need to know about economics and teaches them well, but his tests and quizzes are insanely difficult. Problem sets are pretty easy if you pay attention. Take him if you can, but pay attention. Oh and textbooks = worthless most of the time.
Storng command craft, thorough,

You better be ready before taking this class.  Dr. Dolan assumes you know quite a bit, and therefore flies through lectures. Textbook is WORTHLESS. Nevertheless, a nice guy, good professor and can be very helpful if you meet with him. Also, make sure you show improvement throughout the course.  If you miss class...good luck catching up.

He is very picky when he grades written responses, however, most of his tests are quantitive and multiple choice.  He has a swagger, but also a great sense of humor.  Dr. Dolan cares about his students more than any professor I have had so far at Richmond.  He is accomodating for test times and offers bonus at the end for the problem sets.

His classes make me want to kill myself.  He speaks quickly and expects you to memorize everything he says as soon as he says it.  Some people say they learn a lot, but his classes tend to overwhelm me and as a reuslt I just shut down.
BEST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD.  It was the hardest class I've ever taken in the bschool but you come out knowing more than you thought possible in one semester.

He flips out at students for not understanding what can sometimes be complicated economic concepts rather than patiently clarifying. He is a hard grader, since he wants you to use his lame "key phrases" in explaining everything - just copy them straight from your notes. He doesn't assign too much work though, but don't miss class... ever!
THE BEST PROFESSOR AT THE UNIVERSITY OF RICHMOND....NO CONTEST!
Harsh, unapproachable (if you disagree), a know-it-all. Being smart is no excuse for being a prima donna. Wish I had had Dean.

Professor Dolan is a great guy, he knows his stuff but I don't think that he is the best professor he could be. He treats his students like his inferior subjects instead of trying to make them want to do well in his class and learn the material.  I think he has a tendency to over complicate things too.  I got a B, my lowest grade yet in B school.

Great profesor, he really makes sure you know what he is talking about.  There were lots of times in class that he read my face and realized I wasn't getting it...he wouldn't move on until he was sure I understood the concept.  Great Prof.  The best I have had at U of R.
Very helpful and forces students to be intuitive.
condescending, i dont think he has a heart.  Can make you laugh and be a pal somedays, but won't hesitate to fail you on his exam the next.
This man is brilliant - a great professor. He can be harsh, but I think it only motivates you to be more prepared. You will be amazed by what you'll learn.

Great professor, an expert in his field! You can learn a lot, and he's always willing to teach you more if you ask for additional information. A little introvert but great guy if he lets you a little closer!

helpful&accessible, i reallly learned a lot from his class. Demands a lot, you can avoid taking notes  but you better pay attention to every topic he deals with, you'll find it in the exams. Usually find it difficult to stay awake in class, but the topics themselves plus stories and jokes did it.
Wow, wow, wow. The BEST prof. in the world! True he may seem to be condescending and mean, but it is all tough love - and he is way better than Dean.

Difficult, but if you study hard and make sure that you thoroughly understand the concepts, you'll be fine.  Unapproachable and condescending when asking for help- I was even afraid to come in during office hours.
very clear, exams aren't that bad. if you pay attention and take notes you will get an a

Great teacher with interesting stories. Take Dayquil before his class though, you're bound to fall asleep. Exams are extremely hard but if you study your butt off you'll find yourself making a B. I definitely learned a lot.
Class is a little boring but Dolan is a real nice approachable guy. Very good teacher, you actually learn alot from this class

I just found this web site and had to laugh. I finally get a chance to review Dolan. HE was my advisor/professor 1982-86. He was not hot then either, can't imagine what he looks like now. My girlfriend was in love with him and became a economics professor

Very hard professor.  He demands a lot from his students.  Sometimes he treats his students with disrespect but it only occurs when his expectations aren't met.  He teaches very well and I learned a tremendous amount in his class.

I disliked Dolan because he was so condescending to his students. He did not treat the class with any respect at all and were made to feel imbecilic if we did not understand. Plays favoritism to students, very rude
His class is challenging but you learn a lot.  He knows what he is talking about and is more than happy to help you outside of class.
Hard, but worth it.  You learn a lot
Easily the best Economics professor at U of R
